Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

scari 0.3.0

  • built on R 4.5.1
  • uses renv for package management
    • updated all packages and specified usage of older versions where code breaks
  • changed main map projections used for models to Behrmann Equal Area, ESRI:54017
    • re-wrote all vignettes to use this projection (it is in meters, not lat/lon)
  • re-ran all models using new projection and updated SLF data from GBIF, lydemapr, and published sources
  • added usage of CoordinateCleaner package
  • streamlined vignette 150_create_risk_report_example_usage to be a simplified example of the function create_risk_report()
  • created example vignette for create_risk_report_USA() function (will be used specifically for IVRs in the USA and is not yet deployed): 152_create_risk_report_USA

scari 0.2.0

  • built on R 4.4.1
  • retired used of taxize, humboldt, rgdal, and rgeos
